sentences.text: Hello, everyone. Welcome to the Slow English Podcast. My name is Emili. In this podcast,
we speak slowly. We use easy English. We repeat important words. Today, we travel to Eastern
Europe. We go to Ukraine. Our city today is Lviv. Lviv is historic. Lviv is cultural.
Lviv is calm and beautiful. Please relax. Please listen slowly. Let's begin our journey
together. Part 2 Ukraine and Europe. Ukraine is a large country in Europe. It is in the
east of Europe. Ukraine has plains. Ukraine has rivers. Ukraine has old cities. Many people
know Kiev. Kiev is the capital city. But today, we visit Lviv. Lviv is different. Lviv feels
old and artistic. Part 3 Lviv is in the west of Ukraine. It is near other European countries.
The city is not near the sea. It is not in the desert. It is on Greenland. Lviv feels European.
The streets feel old. The buildings tell stories. Part 4 weather and seasons. Lviv has four
seasons. Spring is cool and fresh. Flowers grow in parks. Summer is warm. People walk outside.
Autumn is colorful. Leaves turn yellow and red. Winter is cold. Sometimes there is snow.
The seasons change the city's mood. Part 5 a city with long history. Lviv has a very long history.
People lived here many centuries ago. Different cultures lived in Lviv. Different religions
lived together. The city changed rulers many times. But the city kept its spirit. History lives
in walls. History lives in streets. Part 6 the Old Town. The heart of Lviv is the Old Town. It is
a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The streets are narrow. The buildings are colorful. People walk
slowly. They look around. Old Town feels like a museum. But people live here every day.
Part 7 market square. The center of the Old Town is market square. This place is very important. There
are cafes and shops. There are old buildings. People meet friends here. Tourists take photos.
Life feels social here. Life feels alive. Part 8 coffee and cafes. Lviv is famous for coffee.
People love coffee here. There are many cafes. Each cafe is different. People sit and talk. People
find daily life in Lviv. Daily life in Lviv is calm. People work and study. In the morning
streets are quiet. In the evening streets are full. People walk a lot. People enjoy simple
moments. Life is not too fast. Life is not too slow. Part 10 food and traditions. Food
and Lviv is warm and traditional. People eat soup and bread. Meat and potatoes are common.
Food is filling and simple. Families eat together. Food brings people close. Traditions are important.
People respect the past. Part 11 culture and art. Lviv is a cultural city. There is music
and art. You can see street musicians. You can hear songs. The city loves culture. The city loves
stories. Art is part of daily life. Part 12 feeling spirit and goodbye. Lviv is a city of history,
coffee, culture, and calm life. It feels old. It feels warm. It feels human. People feel welcome
you in the next episode.
